style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

Public snippets confirm she is a Gavekal Dragonomics analyst but no reliable Chinese-language display form for her name was found; the current title's 张蒂莉 is not corroborated by any source.
Gavekal's own research site confirms the institution; 龙洲经讯 is the widely used Chinese rendering but only one supporting source was retrieved.

clip_research.source_claim: Mitsubishi's $700 million investment will be split: ~20 billion pesos into Ayala Corp (debt reduction, buying undervalued listed shares, growth), and ~20 billion pesos used for a tender offer for up to 20 billion shares on Mitsubishi's behalf at the same price.
clip_research.public_baseline: Mitsubishi Corporation announced a definitive agreement to invest ~PHP44.5 billion (~$700M/~JPY120B) in Ayala, raising its economic stake from 4.7% to 15% and voting interest to 20%, priced at PHP650/share, with Ayala conducting a voluntary tender offer for up to ~30 million shares.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Consing says the tender offer is for 'up to 20 billion shares,' but public disclosures state ~30 million shares; the transcript figure appears to be a slip or misstatement of the peso amount.

evidence.fact: Consing: 'We will conduct, on behalf of Mitsubishi, a tender offer for up to twenty billion shares in the market, and at the same price.'

evidence.query: Mitsubishi Corporation Ayala Corporation $700 million investment 2025
evidence.fact: Mitsubishi confirms ~JPY120B additional investment, voting interest to 20%, completion within FY2026.

evidence.query: Ayala Corporation Mitsubishi tender offer 20 billion pesos shares 2025
evidence.fact: Ayala to conduct voluntary tender offer for up to ~30 million common shares at P650; expects ~P20B proceeds.

forbidden_claims: Do not state the tender offer is for 20 billion shares; public disclosures say ~30 million shares.
Do not claim the deal is completed; it is subject to regulatory approvals and expected within FY2026.
Do not claim Mitsubishi will control Ayala; the Zobel family's control remains intact.

clip_research.source_claim: Mitsubishi's stake had fallen to 4.7% before this investment, and the $700M (~JPY120B) is the largest FDI the Philippines has received year to date.
clip_research.public_baseline: Mitsubishi held 4.7% of Ayala before the deal and will raise its economic stake to 15% (voting 20%); the transaction is valued at ~PHP44.5B (~$700M/~JPY120B).
clip_research.surprise_gap: The 4.7% starting stake and the ~$700M/~JPY120B figures are corroborated; the 'largest FDI year to date' claim is Consing's characterization and not independently confirmed in the retrieved sources.

evidence.fact: Consing: 'today they were down to four point seven percent' and 'this is a seven hundred million dollar investment, it's about one hundred twenty billion yen.'

evidence.query: Mitsubishi Corporation Ayala Corporation ownership stake 4.7% history
evidence.fact: Mitsubishi currently holds a 4.7% stake and will raise voting interest to 20%.

evidence.query: 三菱商事 阿亚拉集团 7亿美元 投资 菲律宾 2025
evidence.fact: Chinese coverage confirms ~$709.48M / ~PHP44.5B / ~JPY120B investment raising stake to 15%.

forbidden_claims: Do not assert the deal is the largest FDI in the Philippines year to date as established fact; it is the speaker's claim.
Do not claim Mitsubishi previously owned 20% of Ayala stock as verified; the transcript says 'at one point owned twenty percent' but no source confirms this.

clip_research.source_claim: US and China have common interest in AI security and there is room for cooperation on safely developing and using AI, with both having responsibility to the global community.
clip_research.public_baseline: US and Chinese officials have floated an AI dialogue; reports describe a bilateral AI safety notification channel agreed ahead of a Trump-Xi summit, and Track II dialogues on the digital economy have produced consensus agreements.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript's optimism about cooperation aligns with reported dialogue efforts, but no specific agreement has been confirmed; the speaker frames cooperation as an expectation rather than a settled outcome.

evidence.fact: Zhang: 'the dialogue definitely have a lot of room for cooperation because US and China has common interest in AI security.'

evidence.query: US China AI safety dialogue cooperation 2025 agreement
evidence.fact: Reports describe a bilateral AI safety notification channel agreed ahead of a Trump-Xi summit.

evidence.query: 中美 AI 安全 对话 合作 2025 协议
evidence.fact: Chinese report: US and Chinese heads of state agreed to launch intergovernmental AI dialogue.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim a specific AI safety agreement has been signed; only dialogue and a notification channel are reported.
Do not attribute the cooperation claim to a US or Chinese government position; it is the analyst's assessment.

clip_research.source_claim: Growth remains the most important priority for both the US and China, so policymakers are unlikely to accept a slower AI development speed for security reasons.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting on US-China AI talks focuses on safety mechanisms and trade frameworks; no source retrieved confirms that either side has explicitly prioritized growth over safety frameworks.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript asserts that neither side will slow AI development for security, which is a forward-looking judgment not directly corroborated by the retrieved public sources.

evidence.fact: Zhang: 'growth is still the most important thing right now for both US and China' and 'I don't think that's very possible' that policymakers would choose slower development.

evidence.query: US China AI safety dialogue cooperation 2025 agreement
evidence.fact: Reporting frames AI safety and chips as central to US-China rivalry ahead of a leaders' meeting.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim either government has officially stated it will not slow AI development for security; this is the analyst's inference.
Do not present the growth-over-safety tradeoff as a confirmed policy position.

clip_research.source_claim: US export controls on China are comprehensive, China is giving up on relying on the international supply chain as insecure, and self-sufficiency will remain China's main attitude; China is even reluctant to accept eased US chip exports.
clip_research.public_baseline: Chinese tech-policy commentary discusses US export controls and China's push for self-sufficiency; reports note US willingness to ease some Nvidia chip exports.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript's claim that China is reluctant to accept eased US advanced chips is a notable assertion; public sources confirm the export-control framework and self-sufficiency push but do not independently confirm China's reluctance to accept eased exports.

china_advantage.comparison: China's push for self-sufficiency in advanced chips is framed as a strategic response to a comprehensive US export-control framework, positioning domestic capability as the main line.

evidence.fact: Zhang: 'self-sufficiency will remain China's main attitude' and China is 'reluctant' to accept eased US Nvidia chip exports.

evidence.query: 中美 AI 安全 对话 合作 2025 协议
evidence.fact: Chinese commentary describes US high-end chip export restrictions and China's response.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim China has officially refused eased US chip exports; the transcript says 'kind of reluctant' and no official statement was retrieved.
Do not claim the export-control framework has been fully mapped or that all possible supplies are blocked as verified fact.

clip_research.source_claim: US labs' IP-theft/distillation accusations against Chinese firms are 'true to certain extent,' but the accusations also serve to protect US companies' business model against low-cost Chinese open-weight models.
clip_research.public_baseline: AI-governance literature discusses distillation and open-weight models; no retrieved source confirms or denies specific IP-theft accusations against Chinese firms.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript concedes the accusations have some validity while framing them as commercial protectionism; this dual framing is the analyst's assessment and is not corroborated by the retrieved public sources.

china_advantage.comparison: Chinese open-weight models are described as a very low-cost alternative that can be used at scale, challenging US companies' ability to charge premium prices for advanced models.

evidence.fact: Zhang: accusations are 'true to certain extent' but also about protecting the US company business model against low-cost Chinese open-weight models.

evidence.query: US China AI safety dialogue cooperation 2025 agreement
evidence.fact: AI-governance research discusses distillation and open-weight models as topics for US-China dialogue.

forbidden_claims: Do not state as fact that Chinese firms committed IP theft; the transcript says accusations are 'true to certain extent' and no adjudicated finding was retrieved.
Do not claim US labs' accusations are purely protectionist; the speaker offers a dual framing.

notes: No reliable Chinese-language display form was found for Cezar Consing or Tilly Zhang; the current titles' 张蒂莉 is not corroborated by any retrieved source and should not be treated
The transcript's 'twenty billion shares' in the tender offer appears inconsistent with public disclosures of ~30 million shares; flag for editorial review.
Gavekal Dragonomics' Chinese rendering 龙洲经讯 is widely used but only one supporting source was retrieved, so confidence is medium.
Several public snippets carry 2026 dates; treat date-sensitive claims (deal completion, summit timing) as forward-looking and subject to change.

briefs.speaker: Cezar Consing
briefs.speaker_context: President and CEO of Ayala Corporation
briefs.current_title: 阿亚拉CEO：7亿美元大单，三菱为何押注菲律宾？

subtitles.zh: 他们会派人过来，大概十几个人，安排到我们一些关键运营公司。
subtitles.en: They will send people our way, we're talking about maybe a dozen people, will place them in some of our key operating companies.

subtitles.zh: 我们也会在阿亚拉集团总部安排一些人。他们会帮我们梳理所需的专注与纪律，以真正创造我们都在寻找的价值。
subtitles.en: We'll place some at the center at Ayala Corp. They'll help us out, help us think through the kind of focus and discipline that is needed to really create the kind of values we're all looking for here.

subtitles.zh: 同时我们会定期，大概在董事会前，与他们坐下来讨论关键重点，真正想清楚如何推动价值。
subtitles.en: And at the same time on a regular basis, probably before the board meetings, we intend to sit down with them, discuss key important points of focus and really figure out how we're going to drive value.

subtitles.zh: 七亿美元，这是很大一笔钱。这是对我们公司和国家的重大押注，我们要确保对他们有回报。
subtitles.en: Seven hundred million dollars, it's a lot of money. It is a big bet on our company and our country and we want to make sure that it pays off for them.

subtitles.zh: 康辛先生，能否进一步说明这七亿美元具体打算怎么用，怎么分配？
subtitles.en: Right, and Mr. Consing, if you could elaborate more on what you actually plan to do then with the seven hundred million, how do you plan to let's call it disperse that?

subtitles.zh: 好的，这七亿美元，大约相当于四百五十亿比索左右。
subtitles.en: All right, the seven hundred million, of the seven hundred million dollars, that's about forty five billion pesos more or less.

subtitles.zh: 我们会把两百亿比索投入阿亚拉集团，为此发行股份。这两百亿比索用途：第一，降低债务。
subtitles.en: We'll take twenty billion pesos into Ayala Corp right, we'll issue shares for that. So that twenty billion pesos we'll use: number one, reduce debt.

subtitles.zh: 第二，配置一些我们认为严重低估的上市公司的权益。第三，发展部分业务。
subtitles.en: Number two, acquire shares in some of our listed companies that we feel are grossly undervalued. And number three, grow some of our businesses.

subtitles.zh: 这是四百五十亿比索中的两百亿。另外两百亿将用于要约收购。
subtitles.en: So that's twenty billion of the forty five billion pesos. The twenty billion of that forty five billion pesos will also be used in a tender offer.

subtitles.zh: 我们将代表三菱，在市场上进行最多两百亿股的要约收购，价格相同。
subtitles.en: We will conduct, on behalf of Mitsubishi, a tender offer for up to twenty billion shares in the market, and at the same price.

subtitles.zh: 所以是每股六百五十比索，无论是增发还是要约收购。
subtitles.en: So we're talking about six hundred fifty pesos a share, both for our primary and for the tender offer.

subtitles.zh: 阿亚拉和三菱之间还会有更多联合项目吗？
subtitles.en: And are there going to be more joint projects between Ayala and Mitsubishi here?

briefs.speaker: Cezar Consing
briefs.speaker_context: President and CEO of Ayala Corporation
briefs.current_title: 阿亚拉CEO：联手三菱，要打造资产生态圈？

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们已经确定了重点板块：地产、能源、金融科技、整体金融服务、出行、物流、人工智能。
subtitles.en: Yes, we've already identified the segments that we'll focus on. We'll focus on real estate, we'll focus on energy, we'll focus on fintech, financial services in general, mobility, logistics, AI.

subtitles.zh: 它们与我们的组合匹配。但更重要的是，我们不仅关注单个资产，还致力于用这些资产打造一个生态圈。
subtitles.en: Right, they match a portfolio. But more importantly, we'll not only focus on individual assets but we'll focus on trying to create an ecosystem with these assets.

subtitles.zh: 因为逐个资产当然能创造价值，但更令人兴奋的是，我们能以现有资产组合打造一个生态圈。
subtitles.en: Because we can certainly create value asset by asset, but what is more exciting is actually if we can create an ecosystem with the portfolio of assets that we have.

subtitles.zh: 再多讲讲。好的，这是一笔七亿美元的投资，约合一千两百亿日元。
subtitles.en: Tell us more, tell us more. Well, look, this is a seven hundred million dollar investment, it's about one hundred twenty billion yen.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是菲律宾今年迄今获得的最大一笔外商直接投资。对阿亚拉来说，这极其重要。
subtitles.en: I think it's the largest FDI that the Philippines will be getting, has gotten year to date. Okay, certainly for Ayala it's extremely significant.

subtitles.zh: 这是对我们公司和国家的真正押注。三菱曾一度持有我们百分之二十的权益，后来管理组合，持仓下降。
subtitles.en: You know, this is a real bet on our company and on our country. Mitsubishi at one point owned twenty percent of our stock and over time they managed their portfolio so their holding came down.

subtitles.zh: 几年前降到，今天降到百分之四点七。但他们看现在的局面，看国家的人口结构，看良好宏观的潜力。
subtitles.en: And a few years ago they were down to, and today they were down to four point seven percent. But they look at the situation now, they look at the demographics of the country, they look at the potential for good macro.

subtitles.zh: 他们看阿亚拉的定位，看人们对公司和业务的信任，看我们如何更努力地经营资产。
subtitles.en: They look at how Ayala is positioned, they look at the trust that people have in our company and in our businesses, they look at how we've begun to work the assets much harder.

subtitles.zh: 他们看了我们做的结构优化举措，同意我们的判断：现在是重仓阿亚拉和菲律宾的时候。
subtitles.en: They've looked at the rationalization moves that we've made and they've said, they've agreed with us, this is the time, right, this is the time to bet big on Ayala and on the Philippines.

subtitles.zh: 三菱是长期参与者，这是长期资金，超长期资金。阿亚拉也一样，是近两百年历史、扎根菲律宾的公司。
subtitles.en: Mitsubishi, these are long term players, right, this is long term money, long long term money. In the same way that Ayala is a two hundred year, almost a two hundred year old company committed to the Philippines.

subtitles.zh: 我们谈的是长期价值创造，而且要以股东在短期也能看到的方式来做。长期价值创造，但短期就应见成果。
subtitles.en: We're talking long term value creation here and we'll do it in a way that frankly shareholders should see even in the short term. So we're talking long term value creation but they should see results in the short term.

subtitles.zh: 通过偿还债务、严格各业务单元的回报率要求、争取更多分红、向股东分配更多分红。
subtitles.en: Right, by paying down debt, by being rigorous with our ROE requirements and the part of various business units, by demanding more dividends, by distributing more dividends to shareholders.

subtitles.zh: 并更清晰地沟通我们在短期和中期的计划。我认为我们能在短期和中期为股东创造那类价值。
subtitles.en: And by frankly doing a better job of communicating what we want to do in the short term and in the medium term. I think we'll create the kind of value for shareholders in the short and medium term.

subtitles.zh: 康辛先生，这确实是近期市场关注点。访谈开始时您也提到，他们看权益资产价格，认为有价值。
subtitles.en: And it certainly has been a concern especially of late, Mr. Consing. And I think you started, we started the interview and you alluded to the fact that they had to look at maybe the share price and said there was value there.

subtitles.zh: 能否问一下，人们一直在想为什么当地市场估值压缩这么多。是权益资产价格本身，不是总回报。

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.

briefs.speaker: Cezar Consing
briefs.speaker_context: President and CEO of Ayala Corporation
briefs.current_title: 阿亚拉CEO：7亿美元大单，三菱为何押注菲律宾？

subtitles.zh: 他们会派人过来，大概十几个人，安排到我们一些关键运营公司。
subtitles.en: They will send people our way, we're talking about maybe a dozen people, will place them in some of our key operating companies.

subtitles.zh: 我们也会在阿亚拉集团总部安排一些人。他们会帮我们梳理所需的专注与纪律，以真正创造我们都在寻找的价值。
subtitles.en: We'll place some at the center at Ayala Corp. They'll help us out, help us think through the kind of focus and discipline that is needed to really create the kind of values we're all looking for here.

subtitles.zh: 同时我们会定期，大概在董事会前，与他们坐下来讨论关键重点，真正想清楚如何推动价值。
subtitles.en: And at the same time on a regular basis, probably before the board meetings, we intend to sit down with them, discuss key important points of focus and really figure out how we're going to drive value.

subtitles.zh: 七亿美元，这是很大一笔钱。这是对我们公司和国家的重大押注，我们要确保对他们有回报。
subtitles.en: Seven hundred million dollars, it's a lot of money. It is a big bet on our company and our country and we want to make sure that it pays off for them.

subtitles.zh: 康辛先生，能否进一步说明这七亿美元具体打算怎么用，怎么分配？
subtitles.en: Right, and Mr. Consing, if you could elaborate more on what you actually plan to do then with the seven hundred million, how do you plan to let's call it disperse that?

subtitles.zh: 好的，这七亿美元，大约相当于四百五十亿比索左右。
subtitles.en: All right, the seven hundred million, of the seven hundred million dollars, that's about forty five billion pesos more or less.

subtitles.zh: 我们会把两百亿比索投入阿亚拉集团，为此发行股份。这两百亿比索用途：第一，降低债务。
subtitles.en: We'll take twenty billion pesos into Ayala Corp right, we'll issue shares for that. So that twenty billion pesos we'll use: number one, reduce debt.

subtitles.zh: 第二，配置一些我们认为严重低估的上市公司的权益。第三，发展部分业务。
subtitles.en: Number two, acquire shares in some of our listed companies that we feel are grossly undervalued. And number three, grow some of our businesses.

subtitles.zh: 这是四百五十亿比索中的两百亿。另外两百亿将用于要约收购。
subtitles.en: So that's twenty billion of the forty five billion pesos. The twenty billion of that forty five billion pesos will also be used in a tender offer.

subtitles.zh: 我们将代表三菱，在市场上进行最多两百亿股的要约收购，价格相同。
subtitles.en: We will conduct, on behalf of Mitsubishi, a tender offer for up to twenty billion shares in the market, and at the same price.

subtitles.zh: 所以是每股六百五十比索，无论是增发还是要约收购。
subtitles.en: So we're talking about six hundred fifty pesos a share, both for our primary and for the tender offer.

subtitles.zh: 阿亚拉和三菱之间还会有更多联合项目吗？
subtitles.en: And are there going to be more joint projects between Ayala and Mitsubishi here?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们已经确定了重点板块：地产、能源、金融科技、整体金融服务、出行、物流、人工智能。
subtitles.en: Yes, we've already identified the segments that we'll focus on. We'll focus on real estate, we'll focus on energy, we'll focus on fintech, financial services in general, mobility, logistics, AI.

subtitles.zh: 它们与我们的组合匹配。但更重要的是，我们不仅关注单个资产，还致力于用这些资产打造一个生态圈。
subtitles.en: Right, they match a portfolio. But more importantly, we'll not only focus on individual assets but we'll focus on trying to create an ecosystem with these assets.

subtitles.zh: 因为逐个资产当然能创造价值，但更令人兴奋的是，我们能以现有资产组合打造一个生态圈。
subtitles.en: Because we can certainly create value asset by asset, but what is more exciting is actually if we can create an ecosystem with the portfolio of assets that we have.

subtitles.zh: 再多讲讲。好的，这是一笔七亿美元的投资，约合一千两百亿日元。
subtitles.en: Tell us more, tell us more. Well, look, this is a seven hundred million dollar investment, it's about one hundred twenty billion yen.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是菲律宾今年迄今获得的最大一笔外商直接投资。对阿亚拉来说，这极其重要。
subtitles.en: I think it's the largest FDI that the Philippines will be getting, has gotten year to date. Okay, certainly for Ayala it's extremely significant.

subtitles.zh: 这是对我们公司和国家的真正押注。三菱曾一度持有我们百分之二十的权益，后来管理组合，持仓下降。
subtitles.en: You know, this is a real bet on our company and on our country. Mitsubishi at one point owned twenty percent of our stock and over time they managed their portfolio so their holding came down.

subtitles.zh: 几年前降到，今天降到百分之四点七。但他们看现在的局面，看国家的人口结构，看良好宏观的潜力。
subtitles.en: And a few years ago they were down to, and today they were down to four point seven percent. But they look at the situation now, they look at the demographics of the country, they look at the potential for good macro.

subtitles.zh: 他们看阿亚拉的定位，看人们对公司和业务的信任，看我们如何更努力地经营资产。
subtitles.en: They look at how Ayala is positioned, they look at the trust that people have in our company and in our businesses, they look at how we've begun to work the assets much harder.

subtitles.zh: 他们看了我们做的结构优化举措，同意我们的判断：现在是重仓阿亚拉和菲律宾的时候。
subtitles.en: They've looked at the rationalization moves that we've made and they've said, they've agreed with us, this is the time, right, this is the time to bet big on Ayala and on the Philippines.

subtitles.zh: 三菱是长期参与者，这是长期资金，超长期资金。阿亚拉也一样，是近两百年历史、扎根菲律宾的公司。
subtitles.en: Mitsubishi, these are long term players, right, this is long term money, long long term money. In the same way that Ayala is a two hundred year, almost a two hundred year old company committed to the Philippines.

subtitles.zh: 我们谈的是长期价值创造，而且要以股东在短期也能看到的方式来做。长期价值创造，但短期就应见成果。
subtitles.en: We're talking long term value creation here and we'll do it in a way that frankly shareholders should see even in the short term. So we're talking long term value creation but they should see results in the short term.

subtitles.zh: 通过偿还债务、严格各业务单元的回报率要求、争取更多分红、向股东分配更多分红。
subtitles.en: Right, by paying down debt, by being rigorous with our ROE requirements and the part of various business units, by demanding more dividends, by distributing more dividends to shareholders.

subtitles.zh: 并更清晰地沟通我们在短期和中期的计划。我认为我们能在短期和中期为股东创造那类价值。
subtitles.en: And by frankly doing a better job of communicating what we want to do in the short term and in the medium term. I think we'll create the kind of value for shareholders in the short and medium term.

subtitles.zh: 康辛先生，这确实是近期市场关注点。访谈开始时您也提到，他们看权益资产价格，认为有价值。
subtitles.en: And it certainly has been a concern especially of late, Mr. Consing. And I think you started, we started the interview and you alluded to the fact that they had to look at maybe the share price and said there was value there.

subtitles.zh: 能否问一下，人们一直在想为什么当地市场估值压缩这么多。是权益资产价格本身，不是总回报。
subtitles.en: Can I just ask, and people have been trying to figure out why there's been so much value erosion in the markets locally there. I mean your share price, not total return, share price itself.

subtitles.zh: AC从高点回落约百分之五十。比如阿亚拉地产也是例子。您认为原因是什么？
subtitles.en: I think AC is down by fifty percent from the peak. We've been talking a lot about Ayala Land for example, that's another example. Why do you think that's going on, what's happening?
